overview: Electric Judgment is a master-level light side technique classified under Energy. Channels the Force into golden electrical energy that incapacitates rather than kills, serving as the light-side counterpart to Sith lightning. Jedi Master Plo Koon developed electric judgment as a non-lethal alternative for subduing criminals who resisted arrest.
history:
Force scholars trace Electric Judgment across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in Clone Wars · KOTOR II · The Old Republic · Jedi Council novels established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Electric Judgment into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for energy specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Electric Judgment alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The Jedi teach that this ability must serve life, consent, and the greater good — never domination or fear.
significance:
Electric Judgment exemplifies how energy abilities shape Force doctrine on the light side. At master mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Electric Judgment could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Electric Judgment remains a benchmark of energy proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
